data_fields.name: routine_end_clock
data_fields.donor_constant: hh:mm per row (ta_min stop_h, stop_m); end before start wraps midnight

data_fields.name: fallback_state_end_offset
data_fields.donor_constant: gtime(4,0).toInt() added via addMilis (unit of toInt not read)

data_fields.name: far_npc_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: 300 units, compared squared; branch reads inverted vs its HACK comment

best_idea: A daily NPC schedule is a plain list of (start, end, state, waypoint) rows; the lookup takes the window holding the clock time, wraps midnight, and falls back to the nearest earlier end so an NPC is never without a job.
decision_why: Keep the row list and the fallback lookup, but store rows as zone data on the zone population director and keep the fallback rule as an engine constant; the far-NPC fast path is not ported because its branch reads inverted.
acceptance: A server test loads a zone with a guard row 22:00-02:00 and a vendor row 08:00-18:00; at 23:30 the guard state is active, at 19:00 the vendor state is picked (nearest earlier end 18:00), at 03:00 the guard state is picked (nearest earlier end 02:00), and each picked row resolves its waypoint with no client connected.
